*6 Special Recognition Awards & 13 – 1st team, 13 – 2nd team.
Players selected for MVP, SR, JR, SOPH, FRESH and GOALIE of the Year awards are considered above and beyond the All-League teams and DO NOT need to be included on an All-League team.  If you choose to give out a “Co” award, you MUST give up another special award, not an all-league spot.  There can be ONLY SIX special awards.
